GRR.headline: Dry, comfortable early fall weather until rain next Tuesday

DTX.headline: Small Craft Advisory on nearshore waters through this evening

areas.label: Small Craft Advisory, 15-25 kt gusts
areas.quote:
Gusts ranging 
between 15 to 25 knots are expected through tonight which will help 
maintain more elevated wave action along the shoreline, where Small 
Craft Advisories remain in place.

APX.headline: Patchy frost possible tonight in interior northern Michigan

areas.label: Patchy frost, mid/upper 30s
areas.quote: Another cool night tonight, with some mid/upper 30s in the interior cool spots in eastern upper and n central lower MI.

areas.label: Patchy frost in interior cool spots
areas.quote: Another cool night tonight, with some mid/upper 30s in the interior cool spots in eastern upper and n central lower MI.

MQT.headline: Quiet and warming; patchy fog possible overnight in western UP

areas.label: Patchy, locally dense fog
areas.quote: The interior western UP is 20-40% likely to see fog (potentially dense) formation tonight into Thursday morning, and while IWD and CMX will remain VFR, SAW will be in that zone of potential fog formation.

areas.label: Patchy frost in coldest inland spots
areas.quote: Lows range from the mid/upper 30s inland to the 40s near the lakeshores. This should limit the extent of any frost to just the coldest spots.

areas.label: East gusts to 25 kt, waves 2-4 ft
areas.quote: Easterly winds gusts pick up to around 20kts by the late afternoon, with some stronger gusts to 25kts in the nearshore areas of Keweenaw Bay and towards Duluth.
